sources.title: CT DEEP statewide inland species regulations

species.size: No person shall possess any striped bass less than 28 inches or greater than or equal to 31 inches
species.quote: Striped Bass: No person shall possess any striped bass less than 28 inches or greater than or equal to 31 inches … Daily creel limit: 1 fish per angler; Open Season: Open Year Round; Inline circle hook required when fishing with bait.

species.season: May 4 - August 1 (19 inch); August 2 - October 15 (19.5 inch)
species.size: 19 inch minimum May 4 - August 1; 19.5 inch minimum August 2 - October 15; 17 inches at Enhanced Opportunity Shore Fishing Sites
species.quote: Summer Flounder (Fluke): Open Season: May 4 - August 1; 19 inch minimum length. Open Season: August 2 - October 15; 19.5 inch minimum length. Daily creel limit: 3 fish per angler. Enhanced Opportunity Shore Fishing Sites the Minimum Length is 17 inches

species.season: April 1 - April 30 (2 fish); July 1 - August 31 (2 fish); October 10 - November 28 (3 fish)
species.quote: Tautog (Blackfish): Minimum length: 16 inches; Open Season: April 1 - April 30, 2 fish per angler; July 1 - August 31, 2 fish per angler; October 10 - November 28, 3 fish per angler

species.size: 11 inches for boat anglers / 9.5 inches for shore anglers
species.quote: Scup (Porgy): Minimum length: 11 inches for boat anglers / 9.5 inches for shore anglers; Daily creel limit: 30 fish per angler; Open Season: May 1 - December 31
Bluefish: Minimum length: None; Daily creel limit: 5 fish per angler (including "snappers") (New for 2026); Party/Charter Vessel: 7 fish per angler
Black Sea Bass: Minimum length: 15.5 inches** (New for 2026); Daily creel limit: 4 fish per angler (New for 2026); Open Season: May 16 - November 25 (no mid-season closure)
Weakfish (Sea Trout): Minimum length: 16 inches; Daily creel limit: 1 fish per angler; Open Season: Open Year Round
Winter Flounder Minimum length: 12 inches; Daily creel limit: 2 fish per angler; Open Season: Open April 1 - December 31

species.limit: 6 fish per angler (American and Hickory Shad in aggregate)
species.quote: Hickory Shad: Minimum length: None; Daily creel limit: 6 fish per angler (American and Hickory Shad in aggregate); Open Season: Open Year Round

species.limit: 6 fish per angler (American and Hickory Shad in aggregate)
species.quote: American Shad: Daily creel limit: 6 fish per angler (American and Hickory Shad in aggregate); all state waters closed, except the Connecticut River System
***American Shad: all state waters closed, except the Connecticut River System
River Herring: Alewife / Blueback Herring — The taking of anadromous alewife and blueback herring is prohibited from all Connecticut waters, including Long Island Sound.
White Perch: Minimum length: 7 inches; Daily creel limit: 30 fish per angler; Open Season: Open Year Round
American Eel: Minimum length: 9 inches; Daily creel limit: 25 fish per angler; Open Season: Open Year Round

species.limit: 50 fish per angler or 5 gallons (whichever is the greater amount)
species.quote: Atlantic Menhaden (Bunker): Minimum length: None; Daily creel limit: 50 fish per angler or 5 gallons

species.size: 5 inches hard shell; 3 1/2 inches soft shell (spike tip to spike tip)
species.quote: Blue Crab: Minimum shell width (spike tip to spike tip) 5 inches - Hard shell, 3 1/2 inches - Soft shell; Daily creel limit: None; Open Season: May 1 - November 30; Prohibition on egg-bearing females
Jonah Crab: Daily creel limit: 50 Crabs per Day; Prohibition on egg-bearing females
Red Drum (Redfish): Maximum length: 27 inches; Daily creel limit: 1 fish per angler; Open Season: Open Year Round
Smooth and Spiny Dogfish: Minimum length: None; Daily creel limit: None; Open Season: Open Year

species.size: 12 inches (lakes, ponds, Connecticut River); no minimum in rivers and streams
species.quote: Largemouth Bass and Smallmouth Bass — Lakes and Ponds and the Connecticut River: Minimum Length: 12 inches; Daily Creel Limit: 6 fish in aggregate. Rivers and Streams: No minimum length; 6 fish in aggregate. Housatonic River (MA line to Bleachery Dam): catch and release only.
Largemouth Bass and Smallmouth Bass … 12 inches; 6 fish in aggregate

species.season: Open year-round; catch and release only March 1 until 6:00 a.m. on the second Saturday of April
species.quote: Trout (Brook, Brown, Lake, Rainbow, Tiger and other hybrids): Season: Open year-round; Minimum Length: 9 inches; Daily Creel Limit: 5 fish from 6:00 a.m. on the second Saturday of April until the last day of February; 0 fish from March 1 until 6:00 a.m. on the second Saturday of April (catch and release only)
species.notes: As of January 1, 2026 all trout must be at least 9 inches. Many waters have different trout regulations. Trout and Salmon Stamp may be needed.

species.limit: 1 fish (lakes/ponds from the second Saturday of April to end of February; Naugatuck/Shetucket/Housatonic Dec 16 – Aug 31); otherwise catch and release
species.quote: Atlantic Salmon: Taking prohibited except Naugatuck River, Shetucket River, Housatonic River and lakes/ponds stocked by CT DEEP. Lakes and Ponds: 1 fish from 6:00 a.m. on the second Saturday of April until the last day of February; 0 fish from March 1 (catch and release only)

species.limit: 5 fish (6:00 a.m. second Saturday of April – last day of February); catch and release March 1 – second Saturday of April
species.quote: Kokanee: Lakes and Ponds; Open year-round; No minimum length; 5 fish from 6:00 a.m. on the second Saturday of April until the last day of February; 0 fish from March 1
Northern Pike and Tiger Muskie: All waters except Bantam Lake, Little Pond, Connecticut River, and Lake Lillinonah; Minimum Length: 26 inches; Daily Creel Limit: 2 fish

species.size: 15 inches (lakes and ponds); no minimum in rivers and streams
species.limit: 6 (lakes and ponds); no limit in rivers and streams
species.quote: Chain Pickerel: Lakes and Ponds: Minimum Length: 15 inches; Daily Creel Limit: 6. Rivers and Streams: No minimum length; No daily creel limit
Walleye: All waters; Minimum Length: 18 inches; Daily Creel Limit: 2 fish

species.limit: 6 fish in aggregate (3 in Community Fishing Waters)
species.quote: Catfish (Channel Catfish and White Catfish): No minimum length; Daily Creel Limit: 6 fish in aggregate (Community Fishing Waters: 3)
Bullheads (brown and yellow): All waters; No minimum length; No daily creel limit

species.limit: 5, only 1 of the 5 fish may be greater than 30 inches
species.quote: Common Carp: Daily Creel Limit: 5, only 1 of the 5 fish may be greater than 30 inches
Panfish (Calico Bass/Black Crappie, All Sunfish Species, Yellow Perch, Rock Bass): All waters; No minimum length; No daily creel limit
Smelt: Lakes and Ponds; No minimum length; Daily Creel Limit: 50 fish (taking in rivers and streams prohibited)
Burbot: The taking of burbot is prohibited.
Sturgeon: The taking of sturgeon is prohibited.
